conditions: The identifier is used as a bound local variable by a simple iterator.
limitations: This is the documented binding rule for iterator constructs. The cited paragraphs do not settle behavior under external interruption or errors.

triggers: Check any correction to the cited text or archive representation.

statement: Levin's ISETL 3.0 manual describes simple-iterator assignments as local bindings and says that previous values of identifiers used as local iterator variables are restored when the iterator exits.
